insight: ApertureData raised an $8.25M seed led by TQ Ventures in October 2024, launching ApertureDB Cloud alongside its self-hosted edition.
name: ApertureDB
tagline: Vector + graph database for multimodal AI data.
description: ApertureDB is a purpose-built database that unifies vector search, a knowledge graph, and multimodal data management — images, video, documents, and their metadata — in a single system. Instead of stitching together a vector store, object storage, and a graph database, teams query embeddings, relationships, and the underlying media together to power GenAI pipelines and agents.

modelSupport.notes: Stores and searches your embeddings and media; bring your own models.

edge: One database for vectors, a knowledge graph, and the underlying images and video — no separate object store or graph DB to stitch together.
pros: Built for images, video, and documents
